title: Splitfy
tagline: Deploying a contract with pre-determind split among a group of addresses. Any ETH or ERC20 token sent to the contract will now be available for the recipient addresses to claim in the correct ratio according to the split
description:
Deploying a contract with split ratio among a group of addresses. Any ETH or ERC20 token sent to the contract will now be available for the recipient addresses to claim in the correct ratio according to the split.
Any funds deposited into the contract can be split based on percentage
how_its_made:
